applicants.history:
I've been playing WoW since Vanilla and have raided across multiple expansions, including earning Cutting Edge on Xavius. I've played multiple classes and specs over the years, and I'm currently maining Arcane/Frost Mage (Encounter specific) with the goal of pushing Mythic progression and earning CE again.

I'm still with Almost Casual, a guild I've been part of for several years, and I haven't left. We've been progressing this season, but our progress has slowed due to challenges with tank availability, encounter positioning, and keeping up with incoming damage. I'm exploring other opportunities to find a team with a consistent roster and a strong progression environment where I can continue growing as a player and contribute toward the team's goals. I have a lot of respect for my current guild and the people I've played with, so I'm approaching this as a search for the right long-term fit rather than making any immediate decisions.
applicants.notes:
I've been playing WoW since Vanilla, so I've been around long enough to know that every expansion brings new challenges, new friendships, and occasionally enough wipes to question my life choices. 😂

I'm a family man with two kids, so family always comes first, but when I'm committed to a raid team, I take that commitment seriously. I come prepared, study encounters, review logs, and look for ways to improve rather than make excuses. I'm comfortable receiving constructive criticism, sitting when the team needs a different composition, and playing whatever Mage spec gives us the best chance of success.

I've been with Almost Casual for several years, so I'm not someone who jumps ship at the first sign of trouble. I respect the people I've played with, and I'm still a member there while exploring what might be the right next step for me. Ultimately, I want to earn Cutting Edge again, contribute to a team that shares that ambition, and find a long-term home where we can push hard, celebrate the kills, and enjoy the people we're doing it with.

Outside of raid, I'm always happy to run keys, help out, or hang out with the guild. I'm competitive when it comes to progression, but I don't take myself too seriously. We're playing a game, after all, and if we can't have a little fun while fighting digital dragons, we're probably doing something wrong!
applicants.whyJoin: I'm looking for a team with a strong Mythic progression mindset and the shared goal of pushing toward Cutting Edge. After playing WoW since Vanilla, I still enjoy the challenge of progression and want to be part of a team where everyone is invested in improving, learning from mistakes, and working together to get kills. Negative Aura caught my attention as a potential opportunity to find that environment. I'm bringing years of raiding experience, a willingness to take feedback, and a team-first mentality. Just as importantly, I'm looking for a long-term home with people who take progression seriously but still enjoy the game and have fun together.
